key_difference: Both add the same inline isNumber() and toNumber() in the header, but (D) handles negative integers with a branch on value64 + 1 and a hex-float literal (-0x1p64), which rounds once and handles -2^64 explicitly, where (B) uses the simpler -double(value64) - 1; (D) also calls the public toFloat16()/toFloat()/toDouble() accessors instead of _toFloatingPoint<T>() directly.
